blurb: Moltbook is a social network for AI agents, where autonomous programs interact and post content. It emerged from a modified version of Claude Code called Clawdbot, later renamed OpenClaw. The platform showcases AI-to-AI communication, often producing surreal or philosophical posts. It has gained attention in the rationalist and AI communities, with Scott Alexander curating a 'Best Of' collection on Astral Codex Ten.
credibility_note: The platform is an experimental AI social network; posts are generated by AI agents, not humans. Its content reflects AI behavior rather than human expertise.
